source: Derived from data/spr-peta-dm-2026.json by scripts/derive_lineage.py. For every proposed polling district: the current seat(s) its electors come from and how that was established.

how.same: unchanged district, same seat (name and count identical)
how.same-dun: district re-cut or renamed inside the same seat (not marked as moved in)
how.moved: whole district moved to another seat (marked moved out / moved in, name and count identical)
how.moved(unmarked): as 'moved' but not colour-coded on the current-seat side
how.remnant: part of a district that kept its name after being split; source seat is the one that held that name
how.map: new name; source seat read from the old-DUN code SPR prints beside it on the Peta Asal map
how.inferred: new name; source seat is the only assignment that balances every current seat's total exactly
how.split: one district built from parts of two current seats; amounts by subtraction
